statement: Lambda GPU Cloud lists on-demand H100 SXM at $3.99 per GPU-hour on the 8-GPU plan, with per-GPU rates rising to $4.29 for a single-GPU plan.
why: Published rental rates from a named GPU cloud are a daily confirmation overlay on where merchant-GPU compute clears, though no baseline or prior price appears on the page.

impact.mechanism: Listed rental rates set the observable clearing price for renting merchant-GPU capacity; without a stated prior level this is a static level only.

evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA H100 SXM 8x GPU plan: $3.99 per GPU/hour.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public pricing page, but a secondary open-web source with no stated update date; treated as a captured snapshot.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 6.69 -> 3.99 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (lambda.ai)
